c.text: The top 5% found before you need them.
Most agencies start searching when you call. We map each discipline continuously, so the shortlist already exists on the day you need it.
We map the market per discipline and keep those specialists warm, instead of starting from zero on each request.
Every specialist is assessed against the criteria that decide success on a capital project.
People who have run these roles themselves decide who makes the list.
